question: What is the top speed of the Namo Bharat train operating on the Delhi-Meerut Regional Rapid Transit System (RRTS)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**160 km/h**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Namo Bharat, India’s fastest train, operates at a top speed of 160 km/h on the Delhi-Meerut RRTS corridor.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Namo Bharat train runs at 160 km/h, making it the fastest operational train in India.**
 
• **It operates on the Delhi-Meerut RRTS corridor, connecting two key urban centers in under 60 minutes.**
 
• **The train is designed to run on dedicated high-speed corridors with advanced safety systems like ATP, ATC, and ATO.**
 
• **The speed of 160 km/h sets a new benchmark for regional rapid transit systems in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Namo Bharat__ **

 __
 
• **India's fastest operational train, running at 160 km/h.**
 
• **Operates on the Delhi-Meerut RRTS corridor, connecting New Ashok Nagar to Meerut South in under 60 minutes.**
 
• **Supports the vision of improving regional connectivity and reducing road congestion.**
 
 ** **
 
• **Delhi-Meerut RRTS__ **
 __
 
• **A modern rapid transit system designed for high-speed travel between urban centers.**
 
• **The full corridor will span 82.15 km with 16 stations, providing quick and efficient intercity travel.**
 
 ** **
 
• **Gatimaan Express and Vande Bharat__ **
 
 
• **Both trains were previously the fastest in India, but their speed is now capped at 130 km/h due to regulatory restrictions.**
